fields.name: predictionId
fields.description: Prediction.deriveId(eventId, modelName, modelVersion): 64 lowercase hex, stable on replay

fields.name: eventId
fields.description: The scored feature vector's eventId: the join back to it

fields.name: eventTime
fields.description: The event's time, copied from the feature vector, ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: sensor
fields.description: The sensor that captured the event

fields.name: connectionUid
fields.description: Zeek's connection uid: the scorer's key with the sensor

fields.name: clientIp
fields.description: The connection's client: the sender of a request to port 102

fields.name: serverIp
fields.description: The connection's server: the PLC on port 102

fields.name: modelName
fields.description: The detector bundle's name

fields.name: modelVersion
fields.description: The detector bundle's version

fields.name: modelSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of the detector's model.onnx

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: The feature schema scored, s7comm-feature-v1

fields.name: schemaHash
fields.description: That schema's content hash

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: WARMUP (the first 64 events since the connection's last reset: a new connection, a TTL expiry, a restore or a restart), NORMAL, ANOMALY, or UNSCORABLE (a non-finite score)

fields.name: score
fields.description: The last event's weighted reconstruction error; null unless NORMAL or ANOMALY

fields.name: pValue
fields.description: Its conformal p-value against its group's calibration scores; null unless NORMAL or ANOMALY

fields.name: scoreGroup
fields.description: RESPONSE, READ_REQUEST, WRITE_REQUEST or OTHER_REQUEST: the calibration group that judges the event

fields.name: alpha
fields.description: The alpha that applies to the group: ANOMALY iff pValue <= alpha

fields.name: eventsSinceReset
fields.description: The connection's events since the scorer last reset, this one included; decisions before about the 64th carry the model's post-reset false-alarm rate

fields.name: qualityFlags
fields.description: OR of this vector's quality flags and those of every vector in the window

fields.name: inferenceMicros
fields.description: Inference time in microseconds; 0 unless the detector ran

fields.name: producedAt
fields.description: When the prediction was emitted, ISO-8601 UTC
